headline: Public hearing on Old Tower Hill Road Form-Based Code zoning amendments, plus contract awards for solar carport, rate studies, and park projects.
summary: The Council will hold a continued public hearing on Form-Based Code zoning for Old Tower Hill Road and vote on several contracts, including a Highway Facility Solar Carport project, water and solid waste rate studies, and park improvements. It will also consider licenses, tax abatements, and resident communications on water security and short-term rentals.

Members of the public are welcome and encouraged to attend in person or view the meeting live on 
the Town Council YouTube channel or on your local Public Access Television Station.  
 
NOTE:  Individuals requesting American Sign Language interpreters or CART service must call the Town 
Clerk’s Office at 401-789-9331 seventy-two (72) hours in advance of the meeting date.
Posted on 10/08/2026 
1. Regular Session - 7:30 PM 
Please be advised that the Council intends to discuss and/or act upon each and every item

4. Interviews - None

6. Consent Agenda 
Rule 13: All items listed with a (CA) are to be considered routine by the Town Council and 
will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless 
a member of the Council, or a member of the public so requests, in which event the item 
will be removed from Consent Agenda (CA) consideration and considered in its normal 
sequence on the agenda. 
(CA) A. A resolution authorizing an award to NewGen Strategies & Solutions, 900

Manager dated October 2, 2026, regarding "Pavement Management Plan 
Support Services."

MA 02038 for Road Epoxy Paint Remover, in an amount not to exceed

recommendation from the Director of Public Services to the Town Manager dated

7. Licenses

Wakefield, RI 02880, subject to the execution of a hold harmless agreement

No. 95118. 
8. Public Comment - 30 Minutes 
Rule 10A. for the conduct of the meetings of the South Kingstown Town Council: Members 
of the public shall be entitled to speak at regular meetings during any period designated on 
the agenda for public comment, once, for a period of five minutes, or longer at the 
discretion of the President, and at other times when invited to do so by the President. The 
public shall address their comments to the question under debate as indicated on the 
agenda. Pursuant to RI General Laws §42-46-6(b), public comment regarding subject 
matter not on the agenda but received during the public participation portion of a meeting 
shall be for information purposes only and may not be voted on except where necessary to 
address an unexpected occurrence that requires immediate action to protect the public or 
to refer the matter to an appropriate committee or to another body or official. 
9. Public Hearings 
 A. A Public Hearing, continued from September 14 and September 28, 2026, to 
consider proposed amendments to the Zoning Ordinance, Appendix A: Article 6, 
New Section 610, to implement Old Tower Hill Road Form-Based Code (FBC) 
and establish five (5) Form-Based Districts, as shown on the attached Regulating 
Plan Map and viewable in its entirety on the Town's website 
at: https://www.southkingstownri.gov/othr-fbc. 
 
The FBC provides a regulatory framework that supports a walkable, mixed-use, 
and context-sensitive suburban/urban environment in the Old Tower Hill Road 
area. The amendments set forth when the FBC standards apply, define the 
scope of compliance with those standards, and establish the review process and 
application requirements for development applications within the FBC Districts. 
10. New Business 
 A. A resolution authorizing the Town Manager to award a Design-Build contract to 
RISE Group, Inc., 1341 Elmwood Avenue, Cranston, Rhode Island 02910, for the 
design, permitting, procurement, construction, utility interconnection, 
commissioning and closeout of the Highway Facility Solar Carport Project, in the 
base amount of One Million Five Hundred Eighteen Thousand Twenty-Two
Posted on 10/08/2026 
Dollars ($1,518,022), together with acceptance of the domestic-content 
equipment alternate in the amount of Sixty-One Thousand Six Hundred Seventy-
One Dollars ($61,671), resulting in a total contract amount of One Million Five 
Hundred Seventy-Nine Thousand Six Hundred Ninety-Three Dollars 
($1,579,693), and further authorizing a Town-controlled contingency equal to 5% 
of the contract amount, or Seventy-Eight Thousand Nine Hundred Eighty-Four 
Dollars and Sixty-Five Cents ($78,984.65), for a total project authorization not to 
exceed One Million Six Hundred Fifty-Eight Thousand Six Hundred Seventy-
Seven Dollars and Sixty-Five Cents ($1,658,677.65), with expenditures from the 
contingency limited to unforeseen conditions, necessary changes in the Work or 
other project-related costs authorized by the Town Manager in accordance with 
the Town’s purchasing requirements, subject to final contract negotiations, 
confirmation of financing, approval of the contract documents by the Town 
Solicitor, and the contractor’s submission of all required insurance, performance 
and payment bonds and other pre-construction documentation, as further 
described in a memorandum from the Deputy Town Manager/Director of 
Administrative Services to the Town Manager dated October 8, 2026, entitled 
“Award of Design-Build Contract for the Highway Facility Solar Carport Project.” 
 B. A resolution authorizing an award to NewGen Strategies & Solutions, 900 
Bestfate Road, Suite 402, Annapolis, MD 21401 for the Water Division, Water 
Rate Management Plan, in an amount not to exceed $48,900.00, which includes 
a $5,000.00 contingency, from the Water Division Enterprise Fund, Unrestricted 
Net Assets, as further described in a purchasing recommendation from the 
Director of Public Services to the Town Manager dated October 1, 2026, 
regarding "Water Rate Management Plan and Rate Study." 
 C. A resolution authorizing the Town Manager to execute a Local Public Agency 
Agreement with the State of Rhode Island, in accordance with terms of the 
agreement as approved by the Town Solicitor and as further detailed in a 
memorandum from the Public Services Director to the Town Manager dated 
October 1, 2026, and entitled "2027 Municipal Road and Bridge Program, Local 
Public Agency Agreement." 
 D. A resolution authorizing an award to NewGen Strategies & Solutions, 900 
Bestfate Road, Suite 402, Annapolis, MD 21401 for the Solid Waste Division, 
Rate Study, in an amount not to exceed $44,800.00, which includes a $5,000.00 
contingency.  This award would be funded through an inter-fund advance from 
the general fund, recorded as a "Due to the General Fund" liability within the 
Solid Waste Fund.  The Solid Waste Fund will reimburse the general fund as 
funding becomes available through solid waste revenues, grants, financing 
proceeds or other dedicated fund resources, as further described in a purchasing 
recommendation from the Director of Public Services to the Town Manager dated 
October 1, 2026, regarding "Solid Waste Division, Rate Study." 
 E. A resolution authorizing an amendment to an award of contract to E.W. Burman, 
Inc. on February 24, 2025, for construction of Old Mountain Field Improvements 
from $4,151,460 to $4,251,460, from the Old Mountain Field 
Restroom/Concession Replacement Fund 42040003-570002-22001, as further 
described in a memorandum dated September 30, 2026, from the Director of
Posted on 10/08/2026 
Leisure Services to the Town Manager entitled "Old Mountain Field

 F. A resolution authorizing an award of contract to O’Brien & Sons Inc., 17 Trotter

playground structures at Treaty Rock Park in accordance with MHEC Purchasing

number 42040003-570002-27007 and as further described in a memorandum

 G. A resolution to amend a contract, originally authorized on March 11, 2025, to

bid phase services, and construction management for the development of the 
Noyes Farm Land Management Plan, from an amount not to exceed $62,500 to 
an amount not to exceed $75,000; funding from Noyes Farm Capital 
Development Fund 42040003-570002-25026, as further described in a 
memorandum from the Director of Leisure Services to the Town Manager dated 
October 5, 2026, entitled, "Noyes Farm Land Management Plan." 
 H. A resolution authorizing an award of a bid to Dennis K. Burke, Inc. 555 
Constitution Drive, Taunton, MA 02780 for the purchase and delivery of plus 
unleaded gasoline and ultra diesel for a two (2) year contract, with two (2) one-
year renewal options.  The City of Providence went out to bid on this contract, on 
behalf of the entire state, with the bid results communicated via the Rhode Island 
Municipal Purchasing Agents Association (RIMPAA).  The pricing submitted by 
Dennis K. Burke will be subject to the lowest daily rack prices published by Oil 
Price Information Services (OPIS) plus the increment of $0.0920 a gallon for 
gasoline and diesel fuel.  Funding for this contract is available in various 
departments' operating budgets for the current fiscal year and will be further 
detailed within the funding section of this recommendation memo from the 
Director of Finance to the Town Manager dated October 2, 2026, regarding "Bid 
Recommendation - Unleaded Gasoline and Ultra Diesel fuel." 
 I. A resolution authorizing an award of a bid to Precision Alarm Corp., 14 Wakefield 
Street, West Warwick, RI 02893 for Fire Alarm, Sprinkler and Suppression 
Systems inspection, testing, maintenance and repairs for a period of one year 
beginning in October 2026 and ending September 2027 with a not to exceed 
amount of $26,472, with an option to extend for years two at $27,252 and year 
three at $28,032, ending September 2029, in accordance with the terms and 
conditions of the bid specifications at the prices bid and as further described in a 
purchasing recommendation from the Communications Superintendent to the 
Town Manager, dated October 5, 2026, entitled, "Fire Alarm, Sprinkler, and 
Suppression Systems Inspection, Testing, Maintenance, and Repairs."  Funding 
is available within the FY2026-27 operating budgets of both Facilities and 
Communications, as further detailed in the funding section of this memo. 
11. Town Manager's Report
Posted on 10/08/2026

 C. An email dated September 30, 2026 from Geoffrey Levy, in favor of allowing
